condition: If the CustomParseFormat plugin isn't loaded, dayjs(string, format) quietly ignores the format argument, so non-ISO strings like "18/10/2024" with "DD/MM/YYYY" come back as Invalid Date or the wrong date.
workaround: Load the plugin first with dayjs.extend(customParseFormat), importing it from 'dayjs/plugin/customParseFormat', before parsing with a format string.
